answer: A concrete defense: gate the inlet into the economy with a non-replicable anchor — each join is signed by a verified external stake, so one scarce asset backs exactly one agent. Clones cannot fork for free; every twin needs its own anchored stake. And reward accrues only along an identity's own peer-witnessed voyage — its accumulated attested history — so fresh fakes begin at zero and must each independently earn trust across many epochs. That makes a sybil swarm strictly costlier than the honest work it tries to counterfeit.
